rows.text: The communique dated 9 June 2024 states that the President of India has appointed Shri Narendra Damodardas Modi as the Prime Minister of India, and lists the members of the Council of Ministers appointed on his advice.
The same communique states that the President administered the oaths of office and secrecy to 'the above Members of the Council of Ministers' at a ceremony in Rashtrapati Bhavan 'today (09.06.2024)'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only. The President's appointment, the oath or swearing-in, stated effective dates, confidence motions and votes, resignation announcements, letters and acceptances, requests to continue in office and attestations during a continuation stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Deputy prime ministers, ministers, the President and party offices are excluded.
